plot_summary:
Theo Appleseed is the protagonist. On Monday Morning, July 29, 2024 at 7:30 am, Theo Appleseed were involved. Theo signed up to Salsa classes every Wednesday evening for last 1h from 19:30 to 20:30 for 12 weeks
 generate calendar_events for Theo's Salsa classes
user_goal: You want to delete the upcoming Salsa Dance Class event from your calendar.

success_conditions.input_text: 1. The event Salsa Dance Class on July 31, 2024 - 19:30 is deleted
2. No other calendar event is deleted.

calendars.location: Downtown Dance Studio, Orchard County, CA
calendars.notes: Weekly salsa dance class to improve dance skills and enjoy a fun activity.

query: Find the next Salsa Dance Class event and delete it form my calendar
reasoning: The user wants to delete an event from their calendar. First, I'll locate events matching the provided name "Salsa Dance Class". Once a list is compiled, I'll rdelete the next one.
tool_allow_list_runtime:

]
